name: ScanTailor Advanced
capability: Deskew, split scanned spreads, adjust margins, and dewarp pages. Strong reference for operator review of archival scans.
disc_specific_gap: Page geometry; no documented physical disc/aperture pair or primary-text voting for mixed label directions.
recommendation: Use alongside this tool for booklets and inserts; use this maintained fork rather than assuming the original 4lex4 fork is current.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: unpaper
license: GPL-2.0-only; individual files also carry MIT, Apache-2.0, or 0BSD terms
capability: Automatic page centering, deskew, and removal of scan borders and other paper artifacts.
disc_specific_gap: Designed for paper; cleanup can remove legitimate label artwork. No documented annular alpha mask or projective disc model.
recommendation: Useful optional document preprocessing; do not apply its cleanup indiscriminately to disc preservation images.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: NAPS2
interface: C# / GUI and CLI on Windows, macOS, Linux
capability: Scanner capture, image/PDF import, automatic deskew, explicit rotation, OCR, and PDF export. CLI has --deskew and --rotate.
disc_specific_gap: General document workflow; no documented weak polycarbonate rim detector, aperture mask, or disc-specific perspective solver.
recommendation: Good capture front end for an archivist; retain the original capture before creating our derivative.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: OCRmyPDF
license: MPL-2.0 application; external dependencies have separate terms
capability: Adds searchable text to scanned PDFs; supports page rotation, deskew, and archival PDF output workflows.
disc_specific_gap: PDF-centered; page orientation is not semantic selection among competing disc-label directions. No disc mask geometry.
recommendation: Use for accompanying manuals and booklets, not as the disc-image processing base.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: cropgui
interface: Python / GTK or Tk GUI using jpegtran
capability: Lossless JPEG cropping avoids another JPEG decode/re-encode cycle when the crop can align to MCU blocks.
disc_specific_gap: Block-aligned rectangular crops cannot express a circular alpha knockout or arbitrary-angle perspective warp.
recommendation: Useful for simple JPEG derivative crops. Canonical development moved to Codeberg; the archived GitHub mirror is not proof the whole project ceased.
observed_activity: GitHub last push 2025-11-18; archived=True; Codeberg archived=False, repository updated 2026-08-29 (not a commit date)
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: pyvoussoir
capability: Detects printed corner glyphs to rectify and split book photographs; exposes page size and crop offsets.
disc_specific_gap: Requires capture markers and a page model. It cannot infer metric disc geometry from an unmarked ellipse alone.
recommendation: Useful reference for a future calibrated capture station. Latest repository push observed: 2020; evaluate dependencies before adoption.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Tropy
capability: Organizes and describes research photographs, with metadata and an extension mechanism.
disc_specific_gap: Research management rather than this automated geometric correction pipeline or a preservation repository.
recommendation: Best lightweight companion for describing, grouping, and reviewing disc photographs and their derivatives.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: CropTool
interface: PHP / JavaScript web application; Wikimedia OAuth
capability: Crops Commons images, including lossless JPEG crops; can publish a new derivative with links to its original.
disc_specific_gap: Wikimedia publication workflow, not an offline batch detector. No documented disc rim/aperture or orientation consensus.
recommendation: Good provenance and derivative-linking reference for a later public archive interface. No uploads performed in this review.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Archivematica
interface: Python / web preservation system and APIs
capability: Institutional digital-preservation workflows and long-term management of digital objects.
disc_specific_gap: An integration destination, not a physical-rim detection or image straightening library.
recommendation: Preserve original capture, accepted derivative, and our JSON logs together. An integration would need explicit metadata mapping and testing.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Kitodo.Production
license: GPL-3.0; bundled components have separate notices
capability: Cultural-heritage mass digitization, workflow control, descriptive/structural metadata, and METS/MODS/ALTO ecosystem.
disc_specific_gap: Large institutional workflow system rather than a drop-in disc processor.
recommendation: Potential host for a processing/review step where an institution already uses Kitodo; not a reason to migrate this small CLI.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Goobi workflow
interface: Java / web digitization workflow and plugins
capability: Digitization workflow management for cultural-heritage institutions; supports integration of processing activities.
disc_specific_gap: Does not document this combined disc geometry, alpha, and multi-angle primary-text algorithm.
recommendation: Another suitable institutional integration point; build an adapter only for an actual deployment.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: JHOVE
capability: Format identification, validation, and characterization; established modules include TIFF, JPEG, JPEG 2000, and PDF.
disc_specific_gap: Does not straighten images or judge physical capture accuracy. Check the specific module before assuming a format is validated.
recommendation: Useful supplementary validation of supported preservation formats; our PNG/alpha tests remain necessary.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: SIPI
interface: C++ / CLI and IIIF server, Linux/macOS
license: AGPL-3.0 core; README also requires a licensed Kakadu source for building
capability: Archival/library image delivery, format conversion, and metadata/ICC preservation or transformation.
disc_specific_gap: No disc detector; JPEG 2000 build dependency means the documented stack is not entirely open source.
recommendation: Relevant delivery system, not our processing base. Resolve Kakadu distribution/build terms before selecting it for an all-open stack.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Documentarist
capability: Caltech Archives project to annotate digitized documents and photographs with content information.
disc_specific_gap: Repository archived; README has unfinished documentation sections. No verified production disc-correction workflow.
recommendation: Catalog as historical archival prior art, not a current production starting point.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: libvips
capability: Demand-driven, parallel image processing suited to large collections and memory-conscious pipelines.
disc_specific_gap: No disc-specific decisions. A general resampling API does not establish equivalence to our alpha-aware EWA Lanczos3 warp.
recommendation: Benchmark as an optional preview/backend candidate only when larger-volume needs justify fidelity validation; not adopted here.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: Tesseract
capability: Open-source OCR and orientation/script detection; candidate for a Linux/Windows OCR backend.
disc_specific_gap: Global page orientation does not identify intended primary text among artistic rotations; language models and box fidelity need testing.
recommendation: Higher portability value than a Rust rewrite: evaluate behind our existing multi-view voting logic. Not substituted for Vision in this release.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: imageproc
capability: Rust geometric transformations and other image operations.
disc_specific_gap: Inspected warp interpolation choices are nearest, bilinear, bicubic; not a drop-in EWA Lanczos3/color-managed renderer.
recommendation: Useful Rust building block, but replacing the current renderer would require a separate quality and performance project.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked

name: opencv-rust
license: MIT bindings; OpenCV license applies separately
capability: Allows Rust programs to invoke OpenCV, including the same native computer-vision primitives used through Python today.
disc_specific_gap: A language wrapper change does not remove repeated filtering, PNG encoding, or OCR costs.
recommendation: Suitable if a broader Rust application later needs this detector; not evidence of an automatic speed improvement.
evidence_level: Official documentation, license text/metadata, and repository inspection; not installed or benchmarked
